pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, sub-polygonal dark regions with soft, fuzzy edge gradients rather than sharp geometric boundaries. Patch size is medium-to-large relative to the inter-patch spacing.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pathway thickness is variable, thinning significantly where the neck meets the shoulder.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, bristly 1D contour along the neck with a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the background.
